CustomField.description: Used to put a visual icon on case view for Priority
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(Priority) = 'Emergency', IMAGE("/resource/EmergencyIcon2", "1"), IF( TEXT(Severity__c) = '1 - Critical: affects many accounts that can not do business.', IMAGE("/resource/EmergencyIcon2", "2"), IF( TEXT(Severity__c) = '2 - High: affects one account that can not do business.', IMAGE("/resource/EmergencyIcon2", "3"), IF( TEXT(Severity__c) = '3 - Medium: affects many accounts, but not a showstopper.', IMAGE("/resource/YellowIcon", "4"), TEXT(Priority)))))
CustomField.label: Priority Icon
